assessment: Strong evidence these were unused disposable instance-store scratch devices before root preparation; entropy alone did not establish recognizable user data.

later_root_action.note: Root separately prepared this one device after receiving the pre-format evidence. This read-only agent did not format or mount any device.

limits: AWS source inspected does not promise zero bytes from every unallocated NVMe read.
Current-kernel zero writes supports first-boot nonuse; it is not an exhaustive forensic proof of every historical physical block.
No raw blocks were read or printed in this followup; entropy observations were supplied by root.
observation_time_precision: Exact counter-read timestamp was not captured; all four zero-write observations were reported to root before its20:27:39Z preparation began.

primary_sources.supports: Trn2 has four1900GB NVMe instance-store drives with TRIM support.
TRIM-supported instance-store volumes are trimmed before allocation and initially unformatted; NVMe encryption uses unique hardware-generated keys.
NVMe instance-store uses XTS-AES-256 hardware encryption with lifecycle key destruction. A separate EBS statement about pseudorandom empty blocks is not an NVMe zero-read guarantee.
